input: Learn to make sourdough croissants from scratch

gold.taskTitle: Learn to Make Sourdough Croissants From Scratch
gold.taskDescription: The user wants to learn how to make sourdough croissants completely from scratch, including building the necessary skills and knowledge to do so successfully.

questions.title: Have you ever made regular croissants before?
questions.description: Understanding the user's existing laminated dough experience helps gauge the starting point of the plan.

questions.title: Do you already have an active sourdough starter?
questions.description: Knowing whether the user has a live starter determines whether starter cultivation needs to be part of the plan.

questions.title: What is your target date to complete your first batch?
questions.description: A deadline or timeframe helps structure the pace and milestones of the learning plan.

questions.title: Are you learning alone or alongside someone else?
questions.description: Knowing if the user has a baking partner or mentor affects how collaborative or self-directed the plan should be.

questions.title: Do you prefer video tutorials, written recipes, or books?
questions.description: The user's preferred learning format determines which resources to recommend in the plan.

questions.title: What equipment do you currently have at home?
questions.description: Knowing available tools such as a stand mixer, bench scraper, or rolling pin helps identify any gaps to address.

questions.title: Is a specific flour or butter type important to you?
questions.description: Some bakers have strong preferences for high-protein flour or European-style butter, which shapes the ingredient sourcing steps.
